title: 100k-point WebGL chart with live DOM tooltips
blurb: 100,000 data points drawn in WebGL 2 on one ElementGL canvas, with a selectable tooltip, series filter legend and pinned callout drawn as live HTML inside the same canvas.
question: Can a WebGL 2 chart plot 100,000 interactive data points smoothly while keeping its tooltips, legend filters and inline point-annotation form as real accessible HTML inside the same canvas?
result: Built on one ElementGL WebGL 2 context with a 4-bit series bitmask uniform, a 64x64 spatial lookup grid and hit-box syncing through updateElementGeometry(). Not yet verified in Chromium 157 or on Chrome 159 for Android.
